Mauritius Imposes Curfew Amid Worst Riots in Decades

Mauritius imposed a curfew following days of unrest described as the worst riots in decades, which began over water shortages and escalated after a woman was shot by police. Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam announced the curfew.
